# hpe_morpheus_network_router_type (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_router_type" "example" {
  id = 4
}
```

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_router_type" "example" {
  name = "Tier 1 Gateway"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the network router type
- `name` (String) The name of the network router type

### Read-Only

- `code` (String) The code identifier of the network router type
- `creatable` (Boolean) Whether routers of this type can be created
- `description` (String) A description of the network router type
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this network router type is enabled
- `has_dhcp` (Boolean) Whether this router type supports DHCP
- `has_firewall` (Boolean) Whether this router type supports firewall rules
- `has_network_server` (Boolean) Whether this router type has an associated network server
- `has_routing` (Boolean) Whether this router type supports routing
- `selectable` (Boolean) Whether this network router type can be selected
